anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

pass_a_gloss: And wholly, having observed everywhere, we shall find some such things signified in the writing: those perfected having other names, being no longer those but others than what they were.
pass_b_english: And if we observe carefully everywhere, we shall find such things signified in Scripture: those who have been perfected have other names. They are no longer those people, but others than what they were.
source_text: καὶ ὅλως [παν]ταχοῦ παρατηρήσαντε[ς ε]ὑρήσομεν τοιαῦτά τινα σ[η]μαινόμενα ἐν τῇ γραφῇ ὥ[ς το]ὺς τελειωθέντας ἄλλα ὀνόμ[ατα] ἔχοντας οὐκέτ[ι] ἐκείνο[υς ἀλ]λὰ [ἑτέρ]ους παρ’ ὃ ἦσαν γ[ενομένο]υς.
